canonical_evaluation_contract: TP + FN == Total Gold across all tracks

semeval_reconciliation.full_semeval_task_scope: Official SemEval-2010 Task 8 is a 19-class problem (9 relation types x 2 directions + Other). EVRYN evaluates the directional Cause-Effect sub-task (Cause-Effect(e1,e2), Cause-Effect(e2,e1), Non-Causal) as an out-of-domain sanity transfer test.

binary_causal_detection_metrics.interpretation: Evaluates ability to recognize causal sentences regardless of argument order.

discrepancy_register.root_cause: In Phase 3.1, 126 direction inversions on gold causal sentences were incremented as FP without being added to the FN denominator. This compressed the recall denominator from the actual 328 gold test sentences down to (119 TP + 83 FN = 202), inflating reported recall. When direction inversion is strictly counted as both a missed true direction (FN) and a spurious prediction (FP), the true canonical recall across all 328 gold instances is 119/328 = 0.3628.

discrepancy_register.denominator_change: Harmonic mean with R=0.5891 -> Harmonic mean with R=0.3628
discrepancy_register.root_cause: Derived from the inflated recall denominator (202 instead of 328). Canonical F1 = 2 * (119/281) * (119/328) / (119/281 + 119/328) = 238 / 609 = 0.3908.

discrepancy_register.canonical_reconciled_value: 162 Directional FP (126 direction inversions + 36 non-causal false alarms)
discrepancy_register.root_cause: The error analysis statement '36 false positives' referred strictly to false alarms on true negative sentences (2,389 non-causal test sentences, yielding 36/2389 = 1.5% false alarm rate, P_binary=87.2%). The table's 162 FP included both the 36 non-causal false alarms PLUS the 126 direction inversions on causal sentences. Both numbers are mathematically correct under their respective sub-definitions.

discrepancy_register.historical_phase3_1_reported_value: 13,292 in exploratory generator vs 341 in benchmark table
discrepancy_register.canonical_reconciled_value: 341 Entity-Focused Chains (Benchmark) vs 13,292 Open-Graph Paths (Whole Document)
discrepancy_register.root_cause: 13,292 candidate paths were generated when exhaustively walking open relations across full raw PDF text. 341 is the clean path inventory when restricted to curated canonical entities. The UI and documentation now explicitly label 341 as 'Canonical Entity-Focused Chains' and 13,292 as 'Open-Graph Combinatorial Paths'.
